subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.2
solution:
The correct answer is "also".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given passage, the most appropriate answer for blank no. 2 is 'also.'
 
• It is an adverb.
 
• An adverb is a word that describes or gives more information about a verb, adjective, adverb, or phrase.
 
 
• Example: *She is a photographer and also writes books.*
 
 
 
• The above example, also indicates that writing books are additional information about her.
